# The coupling closures of deployed training pipelines

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`coupling-closures-of-training-pipelines` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F04 · [record](coupling-closures-of-training-pipelines.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In each published way of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read, so the selection laws' premise holds by construction; three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering what the deciders do not read.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The identification of each pipeline as a web (formations, conditions, coupling) is the AI reading of its published construction; figures are from the papers abstracts, read 22 October 2026.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- What an actual deployed system's pipeline reads beyond what its papers state, or anything about unpublished pipelines.
- That the theory predicts the magnitudes or shapes measured: it predicts none.
- Whether outside evaluators are in fact admitted other than through the labs own coupling.

**Standard boundaries:** A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

A correspondence study (no Lean) reviewed at its stated scope in one session; sources read from their abstracts and the NIST release on 22 October 2026; not independently reviewed.

Canonical source: [CORRESPONDENCE.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/cr1-coupling-correspondence/CORRESPONDENCE.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

A frozen test designed from the theory on a deployed pipeline (a prediction of which beyond falls, fixed before measuring); the language-model agent test LA1; an independent review, including by practitioners of each pipeline.
